name: codex-engineering-lifecycle
description: A delivery-mode Codex workflow for explicit AGILE, AGILE_REVIEWED, or STRICT requirements, Goal-mode delivery, merge, release or no-publish acceptance, and feature closure.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit agile, weak-review, or strict feature delivery.
interface.longDescription: Initialize Requirements, Engineering Main, and Engineering Review tasks, explicitly select AGILE, AGILE_REVIEWED, or STRICT for each confirmed feature, then carry it through mode-appropriate planning and exact-head verification, serialized Goal-mode development, merge, explicit release or no-publish acceptance authorization, and auditable closure.
defaultPrompt: Use $engineering-requirements to confirm my feature request with an explicit delivery mode.
Use $engineering-main to continue the authorized feature lifecycle.
